title: •Flagship
caption: •Flagship (V)
game_text: Deploy on your Star Destroyer. It may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (two if _Executor_). Counter Assault is canceled. During your move phase, Landing Claw is canceled here. Once per turn, may ▲ an admiral or a card with “_Executor_” in game text.
lore: After the Battle of Yavin, it was politically necessary to demonstrate the unstoppable might of the Empire. The _Executor_ and Death Squadron ensured this objective.

notes: Unique. 'Executor' italic both times in game text (inside curly double quotes the second time); slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. No immune-to icon on the slip (printed card has Immune to your Alter). The wiki's default 'Flagship' page carries Glossary 2.0 wording; printed face = 'Flagship (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Dagobah-D-flagship.gif is the PC Errata face — downloaded to src/vs5/38-Dagobah-D-flagship.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: 'Executor' italic (wiki plain). Copyright 1997 (Dagobah). Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
